jobs.title: IT Operations Lead
jobs.description: What is the job? This is not your usual service desk job. You'll be the person our clinicians, pharmacists and office teams think of when they think of IT and, one of a very small team that makes technology work across a regulated, growing healthcare business. Some days that means sorting a laptop for a new starter. Others it means getting a prescription printer back online before the afternoon dispatch, helping open a new office, or working out why a process keeps breaking and fixing it for good. We're a scale-up that still feels like a start-up: things move fast, priorities shift, and there's rarely a playbook. We want someone who finds that energising, not exhausting. This role will suit a self-starter who wants to make a positive difference. We care as much about how you work with people, how you think and how you own things than about the certificates on your CV. What will you be doing? Be the face of IT. Look after people across our offices and remote teams, in person and within the dedicated slack channel. Fix things, explain things, and leave people more confident than you found them. Keep the pharmacy running. Own the reliability of the printers, scanners and devices behind prescription dispensing, where downtime directly delays patients' medicines. Run identity and access well. Manage joiners, movers and leavers across Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID, carefully and on time, because in a regulated business access matters. Look after devices. Set up, secure, track and retire laptops and phones, and help shape how we manage them as we grow. Help build what's next. Get hands-on with new office fit-outs, network and security projects, supplier rollouts and tooling changes. Fix root causes, not just tickets. Spot patterns, propose improvements and see them through, from automating a dull task to rewriting a confusing process. Write it down. Keep guides, runbooks and asset records clear enough that someone else could pick them up tomorrow, and good enough

jobs.title: Estates & Facilities Manager
jobs.description: What is the job? We’ve just moved into a new facility at Winnersh Triangle, bringing our offices, warehouse and secure storage together at a time when Montu is growing quickly. We’re looking for a Facilities & Estate Manager who can see what the site could become and make it happen. You’ll have the opportunity to make Winnersh a great place to work. That means listening to the people who use the building every day and making changes they’ll notice, whether that’s creating better spaces for teams to meet and work together or improving the layout so our pharmacy and warehouse teams can get medicines to patients efficiently. This is a senior, hands-on role with responsibility for the whole site. You’ll keep the facility safe, secure and compliant, manage the landlord relationship, lease and service charges, and make sure contractors deliver. As the business grows, you’ll help decide where we invest and lead the projects that make the biggest difference to how the site runs and how people experience it. What will you be doing? Property and commercial management Act as the main point of contact for landlords and managing agents, and manage landlord and tenant relationships. Lead rent reviews and coordinate lease renewals, break options and surrenders, working with internal teams and external advisers as needed. Manage facilities budgets for maintenance, repairs and service contracts. Review and reconcile annual service charges, challenge discrepancies and track spend across sites to identify savings and improve value for money. Site operations and compliance Oversee the day-to-day operation of the offices, warehouse and secure storage areas, including heating, ventilation and air conditioning, fire safety systems, access control, utilities, waste and security. Plan preventative maintenance and respond promptly to faults and urgent repairs, keeping affected teams informed and following issues through to resolution. jobs.description: Who We Are Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction. Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in. We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute. The Way We Work The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here s what that looks like in practice: Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping. Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through. Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together. Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work. Raise the Bar: We re always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most. Think Long-Term: We design for what s next. jobs.description: About Bobbie Bobbie makes European-style organic infant formula manufactured end-to-end in the U.S., because we believe every parent deserves to feed their baby with confidence, without judgment and without compromise. No mystery ingredients. No shortcuts. Just clean, thoughtfully made formula that parents can trust. But Bobbie has never been just a formula company. When the 2022 national infant formula shortage left parents across the country unable to feed their babies, we closed our storefront to new customers rather than leave a single existing family without formula. We went to Washington. We got loud. And we opened our Heath, Ohio manufacturing facility to make sure something like that could never happen again. That's who we are, and that's what you'd be joining. Bobbie for Change Our advocacy arm, Bobbie for Change, exists because making great formula isn't enough if the systems around parenthood are still broken. We fight for paid federal parental leave, push for legislation to prevent future formula shortages, advocate for feeding equity, and support families navigating impossible situations, including donating formula to parents impacted by breast and gynecologic cancers through the Bobbie Breasties program.
